{
  "sop_id": "SOP-019",
  "title": "Operational Incident Review and Root Cause Analysis",
  "steps": [
    {"step_id": "S1", "name": "Create ticket and assign to self", "role": "Executor", "type": "intake"},
    {"step_id": "S2", "name": "Secure incident record and classify severity", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S3", "name": "Collect logs, photographs and witness statements", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S4", "name": "Reconstruct timeline", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S5", "name": "Identify root cause (5-Why or fishbone)", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S6", "name": "Assess cost, downtime and safety impact", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S7", "name": "Define CAPA with owners and dates", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S8", "name": "Compile report and submit", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S9", "name": "Log DependencyWait while technical findings (D1) or HSE assessment (D2) are outstanding", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "A1", "name": "Incharge review", "role": "Incharge", "type": "approval"},
    {"step_id": "A2", "name": "Lead approval", "role": "Lead", "type": "approval"},
    {"step_id": "R1", "name": "Correct and resubmit on rejection", "role": "Executor", "type": "rework"},
    {"step_id": "R2", "name": "Escalate to Lead after 2 rejections", "role": "Executor", "type": "rework"}
  ],
  "approvals": [
    {"stage": "Incharge", "condition": "always"},
    {"stage": "Lead", "condition": "always"},
    {"stage": "HOD", "condition": "major incidents only"}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"dep_id": "D1", "provider": "Maintenance", "item": "Technical findings", "parallel_group": "P1"},
    {"dep_id": "D2", "provider": "HSE", "item": "HSE assessment", "parallel_group": "P1"}
  ],
  "rework_reasons": [
    "Required document missing",
    "Incorrect category",
    "Amount mismatch",
    "Wrong quantity"
  ],
  "first_pass_yield_target": 0.85
}
